title: 土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良~Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling
focus: 用流變、含水與體積收支評估土壓平衡潛盾改良土的功能~Assess EPB conditioned-ground function through rheology, moisture and volume accounting
summary: 本課聚焦用流變、含水與體積收支評估土壓平衡潛盾改良土的功能。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on assess EPB conditioned-ground function through rheology, moisture and volume accounting. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 塑性土塞的功能~Function of the plastic soil plug
units.title: 塑性土塞的功能~Function of the plastic soil plug
units.mechanism: 土壓平衡依靠倉內改良土傳遞支護並容許受控出土，材料同時需要可塑性與低滲透。過乾會難以攪拌，過稀則難形成壓降，因此不能把流動性越高當成越好的改良。 假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。 過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。~EPB chamber material must transmit support while permitting controlled extraction, requiring plasticity and limited permeability together. Dry material resists mixing while overly fluid material may not sustain a pressure drop, so maximum flowability is not the objective. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting. Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting.
units.verify: 將代表性土樣的流動性、滲透與螺旋機壓力分布一起比較，記錄含水及粒徑；只有可維持壓力傳遞且出土穩定的試驗組合才供工程審查，不能靠單一坍度值認定合格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。~Compare workability and permeability of representative samples with screw pressure distribution, recording moisture and grading; engineering review needs stable pressure transmission and extraction rather than acceptance from slump alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation.
units.failure: 過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。~Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation.
units.misconception: 改良土越稀越容易流動，就一定越有利於穩定支護。~More fluid conditioned soil is necessarily better for stable face support.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄塑性土塞的功能的資料來源與適用條件。將代表性土樣的流動性、滲透與螺旋機壓力分布一起比較，記錄含水及粒徑；只有可維持壓力傳遞且出土穩定的試驗組合才供工程審查，不能靠單一坍度值認定合格。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for function of the plastic soil plug. Compare workability and permeability of representative samples with screw pressure distribution, recording moisture and grading; engineering review needs stable pressure transmission and extraction rather than acceptance from slump alone.

units.title: 含水率基準轉換~Moisture-basis conversion
units.mechanism: 土壤含水率通常以水重除乾土重，與水占濕土總重比例不同。改良效果與黏土礦物及原水量有關，必須先統一質量基準再比較添加量，否則看似相同百分比其實不是同一材料。 假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。 把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。~Geotechnical moisture content divides water mass by dry soil mass, unlike wet-mass fraction. Conditioning depends on mineralogy and initial water, requiring a consistent mass basis before comparing addition percentages or material behavior. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass. Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass.
units.verify: 以烘乾或適用快速方法核對水量，將原土含水、加水和其他液體分欄；抽樣位置與時間需對齊出土資料，設計者只有在基準和代表性清楚後才比較不同配比試驗。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。~Check water using drying or an appropriate rapid method and separate original moisture, added water and other liquids; align sampling location and time with discharge before designers compare trial mixtures on a common representative basis. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance.
units.failure: 把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。~Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance.
units.misconception: 乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。~Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄含水率基準轉換的資料來源與適用條件。以烘乾或適用快速方法核對水量，將原土含水、加水和其他液體分欄；抽樣位置與時間需對齊出土資料，設計者只有在基準和代表性清楚後才比較不同配比試驗。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for moisture-basis conversion. Check water using drying or an appropriate rapid method and separate original moisture, added water and other liquids; align sampling location and time with discharge before designers compare trial mixtures on a common representative basis.

units.anchor: 泡沫體積與壓縮~Foam volume and compression
units.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮~Foam volume and compression
units.mechanism: 泡沫含大量可壓縮氣體，地面量測體積進入加壓土倉後會縮小，故體積比需說明壓力基準。氣泡穩定性和土粒吸附另會改變時間行為，理想氣體換算只提供第一層量級檢查。 假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。 使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。~Foam contains compressible gas, so atmospheric volume shrinks in a pressurized chamber and every volumetric ratio needs a pressure reference. Stability and particle interaction add time effects beyond a first-order ideal-gas check. Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume. Using gauge instead of absolute pressure corrupts compression calculations, while ignored collapse overstates available bubbles. A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume.
units.verify: 核對流量計量測位置、壓力種類及泡沫氣液比例，使用合格試驗觀察加壓後的穩定性；所有體積比附標準狀態，不能把常壓泡沫量直接當倉內有效體積。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。~Check meter location, pressure convention and gas-liquid proportion and assess pressurized stability through qualified testing; attach reference conditions to volume ratios rather than equating atmospheric foam volume with effective chamber volume. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using gauge instead of absolute pressure corrupts compression calculations, while ignored collapse overstates available bubbles. A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning.
units.failure: 使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。~Using gauge instead of absolute pressure corrupts compression calculations, while ignored collapse overstates available bubbles. A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning.
units.misconception: 常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。~Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄泡沫體積與壓縮的資料來源與適用條件。核對流量計量測位置、壓力種類及泡沫氣液比例，使用合格試驗觀察加壓後的穩定性；所有體積比附標準狀態，不能把常壓泡沫量直接當倉內有效體積。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for foam volume and compression. Check meter location, pressure convention and gas-liquid proportion and assess pressurized stability through qualified testing; attach reference conditions to volume ratios rather than equating atmospheric foam volume with effective chamber volume.

units.anchor: 粒徑與細料作用~Grading and fines behavior
units.title: 粒徑與細料作用~Grading and fines behavior
units.mechanism: 細料影響漿體連續性與滲透，大顆粒則影響攪拌和通過能力，但相同細料百分比的礦物活性可以不同。級配分析應連到塑性與磨蝕性，不能以一條粒徑曲線決定全部改良需求。 假設乾樣2 kg中通過指定篩0.6 kg，細料比例30%；篩孔尺寸必須一併註明。 只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。~Fines affect matrix continuity and permeability while coarse particles affect mixing and passage. Equal fines percentages can have different mineral activity, so grading must be linked to plasticity and abrasivity rather than determining conditioning alone. For an assumed 2 kg dry sample with 0.6 kg passing a specified sieve, fines content is 30%; the sieve aperture must accompany the value. Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾樣2 kg中通過指定篩0.6 kg，細料比例30%；篩孔尺寸必須一併註明。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 2 kg dry sample with 0.6 kg passing a specified sieve, fines content is 30%; the sieve aperture must accompany the value.
units.verify: 保存篩分、沉降與塑性試驗方法，對不同地層分別取樣並檢查粗粒是否在取樣時被排除；代表性評估需覆蓋過渡帶，試驗主管確認樣本能反映實際進倉土。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。~Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection; include transition zones and obtain laboratory review of representativeness for chamber material. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation.
units.failure: 只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。~Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation.
units.misconception: 細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。~Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄粒徑與細料作用的資料來源與適用條件。保存篩分、沉降與塑性試驗方法，對不同地層分別取樣並檢查粗粒是否在取樣時被排除；代表性評估需覆蓋過渡帶，試驗主管確認樣本能反映實際進倉土。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for grading and fines behavior. Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection; include transition zones and obtain laboratory review of representativeness for chamber material.

units.anchor: 流變屈服與黏度~Yield stress and viscosity
units.title: 流變屈服與黏度~Yield stress and viscosity
units.mechanism: 改良土可能需超過屈服應力才開始流動，之後流動阻力仍隨剪切速率改變。單點黏度不能代表整條流動曲線，且停放後觸變恢復使重新啟動條件不同於持續攪拌。 假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。 把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。~Conditioned ground may require a yield stress before flowing and then resist flow differently with shear rate. One viscosity value cannot represent the curve, and thixotropic recovery during rest makes restart differ from continued mixing. For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa. Treating post-rest yield increase as permanent thickening can prompt incorrect additions, while continuously mixed tests understate restart resistance. Values without shear history are not meaningfully comparable.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa.
units.verify: 在適合粗粒尺度的試驗裝置量測多剪率及停放再啟動曲線，記錄溫度和歷程；比較模型殘差與重複性，只有校準範圍內才可用該式描述，不能直接換算機器扭矩指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。~Measure multiple shear rates and rest-restart curves in equipment appropriate to particle size, recording temperature and history; use the model only within calibrated behavior and never convert it directly into a machine torque instruction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating post-rest yield increase as permanent thickening can prompt incorrect additions, while continuously mixed tests understate restart resistance. Values without shear history are not meaningfully comparable.
units.failure: 把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。~Treating post-rest yield increase as permanent thickening can prompt incorrect additions, while continuously mixed tests understate restart resistance. Values without shear history are not meaningfully comparable.
units.misconception: 單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。~Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄流變屈服與黏度的資料來源與適用條件。在適合粗粒尺度的試驗裝置量測多剪率及停放再啟動曲線，記錄溫度和歷程；比較模型殘差與重複性，只有校準範圍內才可用該式描述，不能直接換算機器扭矩指令。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for yield stress and viscosity. Measure multiple shear rates and rest-restart curves in equipment appropriate to particle size, recording temperature and history; use the model only within calibrated behavior and never convert it directly into a machine torque instruction.

units.anchor: 扭矩功率與能耗~Torque power and energy
units.title: 扭矩功率與能耗~Torque power and energy
units.mechanism: 刀盤功率等於扭矩乘角速度，能源變化可提示磨耗、黏附或材料改良差異，但也受地層強度和推進量影響。將能耗按開挖體積規一化才能做較公平的比較，仍不能單獨確定成因。 假設扭矩1 MN·m、轉速2 rpm，P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW；非額定能力或推薦轉速。 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。~Cutterhead power is torque times angular speed. Changes may indicate wear, adhesion or conditioning, but also strength and penetration. Volume-normalized energy improves comparison without uniquely identifying the cause. For assumed torque 1 MN·m and speed 2 rpm, P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW; these are neither ratings nor recommended settings. Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設扭矩1 MN·m、轉速2 rpm，P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW；非額定能力或推薦轉速。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed torque 1 MN·m and speed 2 rpm, P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW; these are neither ratings nor recommended settings.
units.verify: 同步扭矩、轉速、推進、地質與改良材料紀錄，剔除空轉及維修段後比較單位體積能量；任何效率結論需同時檢查壓力穩定與沉陷，不能用低功率作唯一最佳化目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。~Synchronize torque, speed, advance, geology and conditioning records, excluding idle and maintenance periods before comparing energy per volume; efficiency conclusions must also check pressure and settlement rather than minimizing power alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal.
units.failure: 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。~Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal.
units.misconception: 刀盤功率降低就能證明改良成功，不必看進尺和地質。~Lower cutterhead power proves successful conditioning without checking advance or geology.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄扭矩功率與能耗的資料來源與適用條件。同步扭矩、轉速、推進、地質與改良材料紀錄，剔除空轉及維修段後比較單位體積能量；任何效率結論需同時檢查壓力穩定與沉陷，不能用低功率作唯一最佳化目標。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for torque power and energy. Synchronize torque, speed, advance, geology and conditioning records, excluding idle and maintenance periods before comparing energy per volume; efficiency conclusions must also check pressure and settlement rather than minimizing power alone.

units.anchor: 添加收支與混合均勻~Addition balance and mixing uniformity
units.title: 添加收支與混合均勻~Addition balance and mixing uniformity
units.mechanism: 添加物總量不代表全倉分布均勻，噴口阻塞或混合死角會造成局部乾團與稀漿並存。收支需按時間與原土體積對齊，並以多位置樣本檢查離散，不能只看泵浦累計量。 假設一段原土40 m³加入液體2 m³，體積比5%；此示意不指定任何材料配方。 總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。~Total additive volume does not prove uniform chamber distribution. Blocked delivery or dead zones can leave dry lumps beside dilute slurry. Align quantities with original-soil volume and time and check spatial variability, not only pump totals. An assumed 2 m³ of liquid added to 40 m³ of original ground gives a 5% ratio; this illustration specifies no material recipe. Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. Blaming all variability on soil can conceal a correctable equipment fault.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段原土40 m³加入液體2 m³，體積比5%；此示意不指定任何材料配方。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 m³ of liquid added to 40 m³ of original ground gives a 5% ratio; this illustration specifies no material recipe.
units.verify: 以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。~Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. Blaming all variability on soil can conceal a correctable equipment fault.
units.failure: 總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。~Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. Blaming all variability on soil can conceal a correctable equipment fault.
units.misconception: 添加總量達標就證明各區材料分布一定均勻。~Meeting the total addition quantity proves uniform distribution throughout the chamber.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄添加收支與混合均勻的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for addition balance and mixing uniformity. Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions.

units.anchor: 滲透與壓力保持~Permeability and pressure retention
units.title: 滲透與壓力保持~Permeability and pressure retention
units.mechanism: 改良土的低滲透性有助於保持壓差，但試驗有效性取決於孔隙結構、壓密和氣泡狀態。過低流量也可能是裝置堵塞，不能把所有零讀值都解讀成理想材料，應確認量測下限。 假設k=10⁻⁷ m/s、面積0.01 m²、梯度10，Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min，需足夠量測靈敏度。 裝置堵塞可產生極佳的假低滲透，氣泡壓縮則造成初期流量遲滯；若據此認為任何停機都能保持壓力，會把實驗假象當現場保障。~Limited permeability helps sustain pressure difference, but testing depends on pore structure, compaction and gas state. Near-zero flow can also mean apparatus blockage, so instrument detection limits and continuity require verification. Assume k=10⁻⁷ m/s, area 0.01 m² and gradient 10; Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min, requiring sufficient sensitivity. Apparatus blockage creates falsely excellent low permeability, and bubble compression delays initial flow. Assuming pressure will then persist through any stoppage turns a test artifact into an unjustified field assurance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設k=10⁻⁷ m/s、面積0.01 m²、梯度10，Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min，需足夠量測靈敏度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume k=10⁻⁷ m/s, area 0.01 m² and gradient 10; Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min, requiring sufficient sensitivity.
units.verify: 使用適用低流量量測與空白裝置查核，觀察試體壓密和排氣歷程；結果附壓差、時間、密度及重複性，未達檢出限以界限報告，不把測不到寫成真正零滲透。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：裝置堵塞可產生極佳的假低滲透，氣泡壓縮則造成初期流量遲滯；若據此認為任何停機都能保持壓力，會把實驗假象當現場保障。~Check low-flow sensitivity and a blank apparatus while observing compaction and gas release; report pressure, duration, density and repeatability, expressing below-detection results as bounds rather than true zero permeability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Apparatus blockage creates falsely excellent low permeability, and bubble compression delays initial flow. Assuming pressure will then persist through any stoppage turns a test artifact into an unjustified field assurance.
units.failure: 裝置堵塞可產生極佳的假低滲透，氣泡壓縮則造成初期流量遲滯；若據此認為任何停機都能保持壓力，會把實驗假象當現場保障。~Apparatus blockage creates falsely excellent low permeability, and bubble compression delays initial flow. Assuming pressure will then persist through any stoppage turns a test artifact into an unjustified field assurance.
units.misconception: 試驗流量測不到就證明改良土真正完全不透水。~Undetectable test flow proves that conditioned soil has exactly zero permeability.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄滲透與壓力保持的資料來源與適用條件。使用適用低流量量測與空白裝置查核，觀察試體壓密和排氣歷程；結果附壓差、時間、密度及重複性，未達檢出限以界限報告，不把測不到寫成真正零滲透。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for permeability and pressure retention. Check low-flow sensitivity and a blank apparatus while observing compaction and gas release; report pressure, duration, density and repeatability, expressing below-detection results as bounds rather than true zero permeability.

units.anchor: 老化與環境相容~Aging and environmental compatibility
units.title: 老化與環境相容~Aging and environmental compatibility
units.mechanism: 改良材料在土中會受時間、溫度、水質與吸附影響，短時工作性未必維持到運輸或處理。工程性能與廢土處理相互關聯，應使用經核准的相容性和環境資料，而非只追求瞬間低扭矩。 假設同法試驗初始流動指標100、2 h後80，保留比例80%；這是任意指標示例而非材料規格。 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。~Time, temperature, water chemistry and adsorption change conditioned material, so immediate workability may not persist through handling or treatment. Engineering behavior and spoil management are linked and require approved compatibility and environmental evidence. An assumed identical-method flow index falling from 100 to 80 after 2 h has 80% retention; this arbitrary index is not a material specification. Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同法試驗初始流動指標100、2 h後80，保留比例80%；這是任意指標示例而非材料規格。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed identical-method flow index falling from 100 to 80 after 2 h has 80% retention; this arbitrary index is not a material specification.
units.verify: 在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。~Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance.
units.failure: 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。~Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance.
units.misconception: 材料短時試驗合格就保證任何溫度和停放時間都相容。~Passing a short trial guarantees compatibility at every temperature and storage duration.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄老化與環境相容的資料來源與適用條件。在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for aging and environmental compatibility. Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course.

units.anchor: 改良試驗到現場移交~Conditioning trials and field handover
units.title: 改良試驗到現場移交~Conditioning trials and field handover
units.mechanism: 小型試驗提供比較基礎，實際土倉有更大剪切、壓力與停留時間分布，尺度轉移須逐步驗證。交接應保留失敗組合及適用地層，不能只交最佳結果，讓下個班次知道何時原判斷不再成立。 假設12組試驗中8組符合預定雙重功能要求，比例66.7%；其餘4組仍需保留原因，不能刪除。 只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。~Small trials support comparisons, while a chamber has different shear, pressure and residence-time distributions. Scale transfer requires verification, including unsuccessful trials and applicable ground, so later shifts know when the original interpretation no longer holds. If 8 of an assumed 12 trials satisfy predefined dual-function requirements, the proportion is 66.7%; retain reasons for the other 4 rather than deleting them. Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設12組試驗中8組符合預定雙重功能要求，比例66.7%；其餘4組仍需保留原因，不能刪除。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 12 trials satisfy predefined dual-function requirements, the proportion is 66.7%; retain reasons for the other 4 rather than deleting them.
units.verify: 交付土樣來源、試驗邊界、量測原檔與地層適用表，現場再核對壓力、出土與沉陷三類證據；改變方案需經地工與設備負責人共同審查，不用學徒算例直接控制機器。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。~Deliver sample origin, boundaries, raw measurements and applicable ground, then cross-check pressure, discharge and movement in the field; changes require joint geotechnical and equipment review, not direct control from an apprentice calculation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use.
units.failure: 只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。~Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use.
units.misconception: 只保留最成功配比試驗就足以說明改良方案適用範圍。~Retaining only the most successful trial fully describes the conditioning scheme's applicability.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄改良試驗到現場移交的資料來源與適用條件。交付土樣來源、試驗邊界、量測原檔與地層適用表，現場再核對壓力、出土與沉陷三類證據；改變方案需經地工與設備負責人共同審查，不用學徒算例直接控制機器。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for conditioning trials and field handover. Deliver sample origin, boundaries, raw measurements and applicable ground, then cross-check pressure, discharge and movement in the field; changes require joint geotechnical and equipment review, not direct control from an apprentice calculation.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示用流變、含水與體積收支評估土壓平衡潛盾改良土的功能需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why assess EPB conditioned-ground function through rheology, moisture and volume accounting requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting.
教學量化備忘：假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass.
教學量化備忘：假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume.

教學量化備忘：假設乾樣2 kg中通過指定篩0.6 kg，細料比例30%；篩孔尺寸必須一併註明。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 2 kg dry sample with 0.6 kg passing a specified sieve, fines content is 30%; the sieve aperture must accompany the value.
教學量化備忘：假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa.

教學量化備忘：假設扭矩1 MN·m、轉速2 rpm，P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW；非額定能力或推薦轉速。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed torque 1 MN·m and speed 2 rpm, P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW; these are neither ratings nor recommended settings.
